title: The visual check's before-hold draws nothing more once a read inside its budget timed out, even if the clock still reads time left
steps: S1: Run the check-pages test of tracy-site-tools, which holds a module write whose assignment read never answers while the injected clock stays frozen.
expect: S1: the test 'a read that timed out spends the budget even when the clock still reads time left' passes: nothing is drawn and the hold reports no drawn page.
evidence: A CI run drew ['/'] where [] was expected (budget 40 ms, the usage read never resolves): the timer fired while Date.now still read 1 ms left
fence: drawFor in check-pages.mjs marks the budget spent when a read inside it times out

cmd: --test-name-pattern=a read that timed out spends the budget
